name: Grapefruit
description: Grapefruit (Citrus × paradisi) is a highly functional citrus fruit valued for its sharp bitter-sweet profile and potent metabolic activity. Its botanical matrix—rich in Vitamin C, pectin, and specialized furanocoumarins—is engineered to modulate insulin sensitivity, drive antioxidant defense, and optimize cardiovascular endothelial tone.
macroIntro: A clean, hydration-dense carbohydrate framework with a non-existent lipid profile, maximizing cellular fluid delivery.
microIntro: A bioavailable micronutrient payload serving as a premier source of Vitamin C and bioactive organic compounds to reinforce immune kinetics and tissue matrix maintenance.

healthBenefits: Immune Kinetics: High Vitamin C yields optimize white blood cell function and systemic defense barriers.
Insulin Sensitivity: Naringenin-rich profiles modulate cellular glucose uptake and stability.
Vascular Integrity: Pectin and potassium synergy promotes cholesterol clearance and endothelial health.
Radical Neutralization: Rich lycopene/flavonoid synergy protects cellular structures from oxidative degradation.

precautionsIntro: Pharmacological and gastrointestinal considerations regarding active compounds:
precautions: CYP3A4 Inhibition: Furanocoumarins block intestinal enzymes responsible for drug metabolism (statins, calcium-channel blockers); check with a physician regarding medication compatibility.
Mucosal Irritation: Citric and malic acids may aggravate gastric reflux or active ulcers; caution advised for sensitive individuals.
Enamel Erosion: Low pH levels can temporarily demineralize dental enamel; rinse oral cavity with water after consumption.
